S01.action: Max pours his champagne over Nora's serving tray and apron, guests around them laugh and film with phones
S01.motion: Max tips his glass, champagne splashes, Nora stays completely still

S02.action: Nora with champagne dripping from her apron, calm cold stare
S02.motion: she slowly wipes her hand on the apron and looks him in the eye

S03.action: Max laughing to the crowd while Nora walks away in the background; through a tall window an old gardener watches
S03.motion: Max spreads his arms and laughs, Nora walks off

S04.action: Max complaining to his mother Viktoria at the bar
S04.motion: Viktoria slowly sets down her glass

S05.action: Viktoria towering over the nervous hotel director in the corridor
S05.motion: the director wipes sweat from his forehead

S06.action: Viktoria on her phone, cold eyes
S06.motion: she speaks into the phone and hangs up

S07.action: the huge watermelon security chief stops Nora in the corridor, then recognizes her and steps back
S07.motion: Brutus reaches for her arm, freezes, then steps back and lowers his head

S08.action: Max watching from the end of the corridor, confused
S08.motion: Max frowns and throws up his hands

S09.action: the old gardener in the night garden watching Nora through the window, a faint smile
S09.motion: he lowers his straw hat slightly

S10.action: Viktoria at her desk giving orders to the plum detective
S10.motion: Viktoria slides a photo of Nora across the desk

S11.action: the detective returns and places a folder stamped GEHEIM on the desk
S11.motion: she drops the folder on the desk

S12.action: Viktoria reading the file, her champagne glass slipping from her gloved hand
S12.motion: slow push-in, the glass falls and shatters

shots.speaker: MAX
shots.text: Du bist hier, um zu servieren. Nicht um zu atmen.

shots.speaker: NORA
shots.text: Das war ein teurer Fehler.

shots.speaker: MAX
shots.text: Teuer? Ich könnte dieses Hotel kaufen.

shots.speaker: NORA
shots.text: Könntest du nicht.

shots.speaker: MAX
shots.text: Habt ihr das gehört? Die Kellnerin droht mir!

shots.speaker: MAX
shots.text: Mama, die Kellnerin hat mich vor allen blamiert.

shots.speaker: VIKTORIA
shots.text: Niemand blamiert einen Drachenstein.

shots.speaker: VIKTORIA
shots.text: Feuern Sie die Mango. Sofort.

shots.speaker: KIWI
shots.text: Das… das geht nicht, Frau von Drachenstein.

shots.speaker: VIKTORIA
shots.text: Ich buche hier seit zwanzig Jahren. Alles geht.

shots.speaker: KIWI
shots.text: Sie steht auf keiner meiner Listen.

shots.speaker: VIKTORIA
shots.text: Brutus. Begleite die Kellnerin hinaus.

shots.speaker: BRUTUS
shots.text: Du kommst mit.

shots.speaker: NORA
shots.text: Guten Abend, Brutus.

shots.speaker: BRUTUS
shots.text: …Entschuldigung. Ich wusste nicht, dass Sie es sind.

shots.speaker: MAX
shots.text: Warum entschuldigt der sich bei einer Kellnerin?!

shots.speaker: JOHANN
shots.text: Sie hat keine Angst. Gut so.

shots.speaker: VIKTORIA
shots.text: Finden Sie alles über diese Kellnerin heraus.

shots.speaker: PFLAUME
shots.text: Name, Familie, Geheimnisse?

shots.speaker: VIKTORIA
shots.text: Alles.

shots.speaker: PFLAUME
shots.text: Frau von Drachenstein… Sie sollten sich setzen.

shots.speaker: PFLAUME
shots.text: Die Kellnerin ist… die neue Besitzerin dieses Hotels.
